lessons.name: Networking and Small Talk
lessons.description: Linking words and set phrases that make conversation flow.

multiple_choice.name: Match the linking words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English linking word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Not only late
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Не само че закъсня, __ и не се извини.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Не само че закъсня, ами и не се извини." means "Not only was he late, he did not even apologise." The pair is "не само ..., ами/но и ...".

true_false.name: True or false: Naprotiv
true_false.sentence: "Напротив" strongly contradicts a negative question: "Не ти ли хареса?" "Напротив, много ми хареса!"
true_false.explanation: Correct. It means "On the contrary".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Stay in touch
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ще се радвам да __ контакт и в бъдеще.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ще се радвам да поддържаме контакт и в бъдеще." means "I would be glad to stay in touch in future." The collocation is "поддържам контакт".

true_false.name: True or false: Vsashtnost
true_false.sentence: "Всъщност" means "at first".
true_false.explanation: "Всъщност" means "actually" or "in fact". "At first" is "отначало".

multiple_choice.name: Match the opinion phrases
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: As far as I know
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: __ знам, срещата е отложена за четвъртък.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Доколкото знам, срещата е отложена за четвъртък." means "As far as I know, the meeting has been moved to Thursday."

lessons.name: Memoir and Autobiography
lessons.description: The -йки adverbial participle and the doubting "бил бил" form.

multiple_choice.name: Match the -йки forms
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English form to its Bulgarian adverbial participle.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Looking back
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: __ назад, осъзнавам колко много съм научил.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Поглеждайки назад, осъзнавам колко много съм научил." means "Looking back, I realise how much I have learned." The -йки form describes an action at the same time as the main verb.

true_false.name: True or false: Dangling participle
true_false.sentence: The -йки participle can have a different subject from the main verb: "Четейки книгата, телефонът звънна."
true_false.explanation: The participle must share the main verb's subject, and a phone cannot read. Say "Докато четях книгата, телефонът звънна."

fill_in_the_blank.name: A great scientist, supposedly
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Той бил __ голям учен, а никой не е чувал за него!
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Той бил бил голям учен..." means "He is supposedly a great scientist...", said with doubt. The doubled бил repeats a claim you do not believe.

true_false.name: True or false: Reported about yourself
true_false.sentence: You can use the renarrative about yourself, as in "Бил съм много палав като дете", to pass on what others told you.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It means "Apparently I was very naughty as a child", something you only know from others.

multiple_choice.name: Match the memoir words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Every evening he wrote
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Имаше период, в който всяка вечер __ писма на баба си.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Имаше период, в който всяка вечер пишеше писма на баба си." means "There was a time when every evening he wrote letters to his grandmother." A past habit takes the imperfect.

lessons.name: Family and Society
lessons.description: Demographics and social policy, and the difference between cause words.

multiple_choice.name: Match the society words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Taking measures
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Правителството __ мерки за насърчаване на раждаемостта.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Правителството предприе мерки за насърчаване на раждаемостта." means "The government took measures to encourage the birth rate." The collocation is "предприемам мерки".

true_false.name: True or false: Kakto takа i
true_false.sentence: "Както ..., така и ..." means "both ... and ...".
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Засяга както града, така и селото" means "It affects both the city and the village".

fill_in_the_blank.name: As a consequence
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: __ на застаряването населението в селата намалява.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вследствие на застаряването населението в селата намалява." means "As a result of ageing, the village population is shrinking." Благодарение на is kept for good outcomes.

true_false.name: True or false: Blagodarenie na
true_false.sentence: "Благодарение на" works for any cause, good or bad: "Благодарение на кризата загубих работата си."
true_false.explanation: "Благодарение на" implies gratitude, so a bad cause takes "поради", "заради" or "вследствие на".

multiple_choice.name: Match the social issues
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English term to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The latest census
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Според последното __ населението на България е под седем милиона.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Според последното преброяване..." means "According to the latest census, Bulgaria's population is under seven million."

lessons.name: Productivity and Time
lessons.description: Time idioms, past unreal conditions and perfectives for typical repeated actions.

multiple_choice.name: Match the time idioms
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English meaning to its Bulgarian idiom.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The last moment
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Той е свикнал да оставя всичко за __ момент.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Той е свикнал да оставя всичко за последния момент." means "He is used to leaving everything to the last minute."

true_false.name: True or false: Kukovo lyato
true_false.sentence: "На куково лято" means "early next summer".
true_false.explanation: It means "never", literally "in the cuckoo's summer", much like "when pigs fly".

fill_in_the_blank.name: If we had left earlier
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако __ по-рано, нямаше да се наложи да бързаме.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако бяхме тръгнали по-рано, нямаше да се наложи да бързаме." means "If we had left earlier, we would not have had to hurry."

true_false.name: True or false: Repeated perfectives
true_false.sentence: In "Всяка сутрин той ще изпие едно кафе и ще тръгне", perfective verbs describe a typical, repeated sequence.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Ще + perfective can describe a habitual chain of actions: "Every morning he'll drink a coffee and set off."

multiple_choice.name: Match the time verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I overslept
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Тази сутрин се __ и изпуснах автобуса.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Тази сутрин се успах и изпуснах автобуса." means "This morning I overslept and missed the bus." Се наспах means "I got enough sleep".

lessons.name: Urban Living
lessons.description: City planning and administrative style, with its preference for nouns over verbs.

multiple_choice.name: Match the city words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Construction will begin
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: __ на пешеходната зона ще започне през пролетта.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Изграждането на пешеходната зона ще започне през пролетта." means "Construction of the pedestrian zone will begin in spring."

true_false.name: True or false: Nominal style
true_false.sentence: Administrative Bulgarian prefers nouns to verbs: "извършване на проверка" instead of "проверявам".
true_false.explanation: Correct. Official texts often turn verbs into nouns: извършване, осъществяване, предоставяне.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Protest against building
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Жителите на квартала протестираха __ застрояването на парка.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Жителите на квартала протестираха срещу застрояването на парка." means "Residents protested against building on the park."

true_false.name: True or false: Panelen blok
true_false.sentence: "Панелен блок" is a luxury villa with a garden.
true_false.explanation: A панелен блок is a prefabricated concrete apartment block, common in Bulgarian cities.

multiple_choice.name: Match the city problems
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English term to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Traffic is restricted
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Заради ремонта движението по булеварда е __ до края на месеца.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "...движението по булеварда е ограничено до края на месеца" means "...traffic on the boulevard is restricted until the end of the month."

lessons.name: Hospitality Culture
lessons.description: Proverbs about guests and gifts, and what they say about Bulgarian manners.

multiple_choice.name: Match the proverbs
pairs: Гост в къщи, Бог в къщи
Don't look a gift horse in the mouth
На харизан кон зъби не се гледат
Out of sight, out of mind
Далеч от очите, далеч от сърцето
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English meaning to the Bulgarian proverb.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A gift horse
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: На харизан кон __ не се гледат.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "На харизан кон зъби не се гледат." means "You don't check the teeth of a gift horse", so do not criticise a gift.

true_false.name: True or false: Sgovorna druzhina
true_false.sentence: "Сговорна дружина планина повдига" means that people who work together can achieve anything.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Literally, "a like-minded company lifts a mountain".

fill_in_the_blank.name: She insisted on treating us
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Домакинята настоя да ни __ с домашна баница.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Домакинята настоя да ни почерпи с домашна баница." means "The hostess insisted on treating us to homemade banitsa."

true_false.name: True or false: Dalech ot ochite
true_false.sentence: "Далеч от очите, далеч от сърцето" means that absence makes the heart grow fonder.
true_false.explanation: It means the opposite: out of sight, out of mind.

multiple_choice.name: Match more proverbs
pairs: The early bird catches the worm
Който рано рани, две гърнета напълни
All that glitters is not gold
Не всичко, що блести, е злато
You can't do two big things at once
Две дини под една мишница не се носят
Nobody works on an empty stomach
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English meaning to the Bulgarian proverb.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A hungry bear
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Гладна мечка __ не играе.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Гладна мечка хоро не играе." means "A hungry bear does not dance the horo": feed people before you expect work from them.

multiple_choice.name: Match the business phrases
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Reached an agreement
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Страните най-накрая __ споразумение.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Страните най-накрая постигнаха споразумение." means "The parties finally reached an agreement." The collocation is "постигам споразумение".

true_false.name: True or false: Bihme mogli
true_false.sentence: "Бихме могли да обсъдим отстъпка" is a softened way to suggest a discount.
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Бихме могли" (we could) sounds less direct than "искаме".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Enters into force
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Договорът влиза в __ от първи януари.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Договорът влиза в сила от първи януари." means "The contract enters into force on 1 January."

true_false.name: True or false: Spazvam sroka
true_false.sentence: "Спазвам срока" means "to miss the deadline".
true_false.explanation: It means "to meet the deadline". Missing it is "пропускам срока" or "не спазвам срока".

multiple_choice.name: Match the contract words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English term to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A penalty for late payment
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: При забава на плащането се дължи __ в размер на 1% на ден.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "При забава на плащането се дължи неустойка..." means "Late payment incurs a penalty of 1% per day."

lessons.name: Science and Discovery
lessons.description: Academic register: the passive, impersonal "се" and scholarly collocations.

multiple_choice.name: Match the research words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The hypothesis was confirmed
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Хипотезата беше __ от последващите експерименти.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Хипотезата беше потвърдена от последващите експерименти." means "The hypothesis was confirmed by later experiments."

true_false.name: True or false: Impersonal se
true_false.sentence: Bulgarian academic writing often uses impersonal forms such as "Установено е, че..." and "Смята се, че..."
true_false.explanation: Correct. They mean "It has been established that..." and "It is believed that...".

fill_in_the_blank.name: The data suggest
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Данните __ на извода, че температурите растат.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Данните навеждат на извода, че температурите растат." means "The data suggest that temperatures are rising." The collocation is "навеждам на извода".

true_false.name: True or false: Izsledvane
true_false.sentence: "Изследване" can only mean a medical test, never scientific research.
true_false.explanation: It means both: a blood test (изследване на кръв) and a scientific study.

multiple_choice.name: Match the research verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English verb to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The results refuted it
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Резултатите __ първоначалната хипотеза и учените трябваше да започнат отначало.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Резултатите опровергаха първоначалната хипотеза..." means "The results refuted the original hypothesis, and the scientists had to start again."

lessons.name: Weather and Mood
lessons.description: Idioms that use weather to describe feelings and events.

multiple_choice.name: Match the weather idioms
pairs: To have your head in the clouds
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English meaning to its Bulgarian idiom.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Out of a clear sky
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Новината дойде като гръм от __ небе.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Новината дойде като гръм от ясно небе." means "The news came out of the blue", literally "like thunder from a clear sky".

true_false.name: True or false: Sled dazhd kachulka
true_false.sentence: "След дъжд качулка" means "every cloud has a silver lining".
true_false.explanation: It means help or action that comes too late, literally "a hood after the rain".

fill_in_the_blank.name: A storm in a teacup
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Спорът им беше буря в __ вода.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Спорът им беше буря в чаша вода." means "Their argument was a storm in a teacup."

true_false.name: True or false: Vitaya v oblatsite
true_false.sentence: "Витая в облаците" describes someone dreamy and distracted.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Literally, "I hover in the clouds".

multiple_choice.name: Match the moods
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English adjective to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Rain makes him gloomy
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Когато вали, той става __ и не му се излиза.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Когато вали, той става мрачен и не му се излиза." means "When it rains he turns gloomy and does not feel like going out."

lessons.name: Traditions Today
lessons.description: Folk costume, ritual and dance, and the beliefs behind them.

multiple_choice.name: Match the folklore words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Whoever hangs the martenitsa
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Според поверието, който __ мартеницата си на цъфнало дърво, ще бъде здрав цяла година.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "...който закачи мартеницата си на цъфнало дърво, ще бъде здрав цяла година" means "...whoever hangs their martenitsa on a tree in blossom will be healthy all year."

true_false.name: True or false: Lazaruvane
true_false.sentence: "Лазаруване" is a spring custom in which young girls sing and dance from house to house.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It takes place on Лазаровден, the Saturday before Palm Sunday.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Playing the horo
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Хорото се __ в кръг, като танцьорите се държат за ръце.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Хорото се играе в кръг..." means "The horo is danced in a circle..." Bulgarians "play" (играят) a horo rather than dance it.

true_false.name: True or false: Survakane
true_false.sentence: "Сурвакане" takes place on Easter morning.
true_false.explanation: Сурвакане is on New Year's Day. Children tap people on the back with a decorated cornel branch (сурвачка) and wish them health.

multiple_choice.name: Match the feast days
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English name to the Bulgarian feast day.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Herbs picked before sunrise
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: На Еньовден по традиция се __ билки преди изгрев.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "На Еньовден по традиция се берат билки преди изгрев." means "On Midsummer Day herbs are traditionally picked before sunrise." Билки is plural.
